graph_node.description: A computer system (10) that visualizes data from an IP rights database as a geographic map with a viewable area, generating and updating data visualizations based on the current map coordinates and restriction criteria.<SEP>A system having one or more processors and memory configured to evaluate information via a computer network, including receiving user interest indications, determining keyword weights, ranking keywords, and selecting advertisements.<SEP>A computer-based system that detects user interest, identifies keywords, determines keyword weights, receives content requests, ranks keywords, and selects content for display with information resources.

An opinion or endorsement of an item provided by a member of the social networking utility.<SEP>A suggestion sent to a user to play a second video content feature based on the relationship score.<SEP>A generated suggestion presented to another user for content or characters, based on preferences and relationship scores.

The term "Processor" refers to a hardware component or computing element that executes software programs and performs a wide range of computational and operational tasks across various system contexts. As a hardware component, the processor executes applications—such as a recommendation application—and carries out the core operations of a system. In the context of recommendation systems, it is used to determine relationship proximities, rank recommendations, and generate recommendation lists. It also performs computational steps such as clustering and estimating within various methods.

The processor may be a component of a network device, where it is operative to perform actions including first and second pass analyses and purging a classification model. When executing software programs, the processor is operable to perform steps such as receiving, extracting, and storing management data, as well as receiving data-streams, extracting management data, and storing it in a searchable format. In some configurations, the processor is caused by a software program to carry out actions such as receiving, extracting, and storing. It may also be a hardware component that performs the steps of establishing user relationships and executing a filtration method. Additionally, the processor can be coupled to memory and programmed by program code stored in that memory to implement the modules of an apparatus.<SEP>One or more processors in the system configured to interact with a computer-readable medium to perform the described operations.<SEP>At least one processor in a system that executes program instructions to implement the data catalog.<SEP>A component that generates relationship data by determining relationship strength associated with each pair of users.<SEP>A processor that generates relationship data by determining a relationship strength associated with each pair of users.<SEP>A component in communication with memory for executing stored instructions.

A storage component operatively connected to the processor in which the recommendation application resides.<SEP>A component of the apparatus operatively coupled to the processing device.<SEP>Memory coupled to the processor that stores program code programming the processor.<SEP>A memory storing program instructions that when executed by the at least one processor cause the processor to implement the data catalog.<SEP>A component that stores instructions for receiving queries, embedding cases, providing query types, and returning subsets.
Money received upon a purchase of an item or for each click associated with an item.<SEP>A payment made to an expert for formulating a diagnosis when the query-for-experts is selected.

The set of members connected to the inquiring member, within which friends reside and outside of which non-friends reside.<SEP>A network comprising a diagnosis assistance system and a set of user devices linking requesters and experts with the system.

The term "User" refers to an individual who interacts with various systems, interfaces, and content across multiple contexts. In the context of search and inventory systems, a User is an individual who has previously submitted search keywords and viewed pages, thereby providing the history used for inventory estimation. In the context of error reporting, a User is an individual who provides feedback on potential typographical errors in a work via a graphical user interface. In messaging systems, a User is a person enabled to move an identified message to another message folder and who may select the multi-pass message filter for execution through an interface on the client device; relatedly, a User is a person for whom messages are sorted into folders and who is enabled to move identified misclassified messages to another folder.

In the context of media and content consumption, a User is a person associated with a client who interacts with video content features and expresses preferences toward characters, receiving content recommendations. Similarly, a User is an individual who interacts with network content and expresses preferences toward characters, and a User who interacts with a user interface and may express explicit feedback favoring a fictional character. In the context of digital media distribution and relationships, a User is an individual for whom user relationships are established and to whom filtered digital media content is presented with priority based on relevancy weights. Finally, a User is a user who has relationships with content producers, has a user profile, and receives presented digital media content.
